Second day in Vietnam and I find an absolute treasure.
Aug 2026 • Solo
Heard so much about the craft beer culture in Saigon hat I had to try one. August, second day in Vietnam I picked this taproom. Now, my favourite in the whole world is Apocalypse Now and I hadn't put 2 and 2 together to realise this was dedicated to the movie and, of course, Joseph Conrad's "Heart of Darkness" novel.

What a great bar. I tried three different beers and the final one I had three of....... Tghis was Kurtz's Insane IPA. What a beer, what a beautiful beer. At $6.55 AUD for a schooner I glad I pulled out to go back to the hotel when I did or I'd still be there.

Taproom is lovely, unpretentious, well decorated, the food was delicious (of course) and the staff working there were an absolute delight. I bought a T-Shirt and a glass there as well (both Kurtz's Insane IPA). Sooooo, Ill be back here at the end of my journey through Vietnam. 

To add to all the time there I started talking to another Australian guy in the bar. OMG he grew up in Eltham, which is where I grew up and he went to Eltham High School which is where I went. This always happens to me.

Cam on Heart of Darkness Brewery and the incredible team there. See you again soon.

The perfect taproom.

Still in Saigon? Come here for beer
Mar 2026 • Friends
I’d heard very good things about HoD and knew I had to check it out. The decor is cool, the merch and coasters are well-branded, the beer options are plentiful and very very tasty. There’s something for everyone here from solid traditional beers to rotating taps. We tried half a dozen thanks to 4 and 6-beer flight options, and really enjoyed the Lemongrass Wit to the ultra-hoppy Kurtz’s Insane IPA. There’s a beer board, where you can pay a round forward.

Hoping my cousin makes it there for his free beers!
